issues: The trigger needs temporal ordering and an elapsed-hour window, beyond untimed ALL/ANY atoms.

labelRationale: A plain inspection-and-customer-receipt conjunction would erase two material timing restrictions. Preserve the independent invoice clock instead of approximating the eligibility trigger.
